reason: I've had a sore throat since last night.
diagnosis: Acute viral pharyngitis, most likely, given the sudden sore throat with fever, hoarseness, mild malaise, no cough or coryza, and exposure to a symptomatic close contact.
keyPoints: Onset and progression of sore throat, odynophagia, and hoarseness
Fever, chills, malaise, and severity of swallowing difficulty/dehydration
Red flags: dyspnea, drooling, muffled voice, stridor, unilateral swelling, neck stiffness
Associated URI symptoms, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, myalgias
Exposure history: sick contacts, COVID/viral exposure, recent travel
Past history, medications, allergies, smoking/vaping, immunocompromise
